title: Pilot Conductor: Guided Canary Orchestration Composer
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design an end-to-end guided composer for creating and managing canary / A-B rollout experiments inside the Redwood Console. Goals: provide a low-friction flow for shipping small experiments, surface suggested ramps and stop conditions based on SLOs and cost budget, make rollback decisions obvious and reversible, and present a lightweight simulation preview for expected traffic and cost. Scope includes composer UI, rollout summary canvas, quick-simulate mode, safety gates panel, and experiment history view. Out of scope: backend autoscaler implementation, full analytics explorer (links to existing dashboards instead).

next_steps: Address ENG-4233 to finalize safety score formula
Create hi-fi screens for guided vs advanced modes
Add QA checklist and handoff doc for front-end engineers
Schedule 30m sync with Metrics team to confirm available telemetry dimensions
decisions: 2) Auto-stop is opt-in and visible on the safety panel with rationale text.
3) Simulation is a probabilistic preview (not SLO guarantees) — shown with confidence intervals.
4) Show incremental cost estimate per ramp step and total projected cost for experiment duration.
accessibility_considerations: Ramp chart uses texture + color for variant differentiation to support color-blind users
All interactive controls are keyboard-focusable and include ARIA labels
Modal dialogs announce purpose and include clear escape paths
implementation_notes: Frontend needs API endpoints: /rollouts/preview (simulate traffic + cost) and /rollouts/validate (check metric availability)
Backend: will leverage existing anomaly detection service via ENG-4102; latency is 10-15s resolution
Store rollout configuration as JSON with explicit versioning to allow safe rollbacks and audit logs
estimate_rationale: 5 points: 2 for guided-mode flows and hi-fi components, 1 for safety panel + simulation UX, 1 for summary + history view, 1 for handoff and QA fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a canary experiment in guided mode in under 3 minutes following the composer prompts
Auto-stop toggle explains behavior and actually prevents further ramping when triggered (backend hookup mocked in e2e)
Simulation preview displays confidence interval and cost estimate for chosen ramp and duration
Rollback button is visible in summary and reverts traffic to previous variant within the UI (backend stubbed)
design_risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Users may misinterpret simulation as a guarantee. Mitigation: prominent copy + tooltip explaining probabilistic nature.
Risk: Too many options in the composer will discourage usage. Mitigation: default guided suggestions with an explicit 'Advanced' switch.
audit_log_notes: Ensure rollout config change records user id, timestamp, and diff for compliance audits
Tie approvals to SSO identity for enterprise customers using Private deployments
